pronunciation: choo (rising-ish mid tone, like 'chew' but shorter)

example.romanization: Kiâ vuk-hâ yû liông chak chû.
example.english: There are two pigs at his house.

note: 豬 is a key part of many Hakka idioms about luck and prosperity (e.g. raising pigs was historically central to Hakka farm life), and the classifier used with it is 隻 (chak), the same one used for many animals.
